name: Titan design system
description: A growing Titan design system, initially informed by the email shell and enriched by future screens and products.

components.name: Icon button
components.usage: Variants: default, compact, composer, dark, dark-quiet, toggle. Dark uses a 24px target; iconSize 16 (default) or 18 supports navigation or window usages with one treatment. Toggle requires icon + pressedIcon and an explicit pressed state; it swaps artwork instead of painting a container. Use monochrome assets with iconColor: currentColor. Legacy window/dark-compact inputs normalize to dark.

props.label: Required visible or accessible label
props.icon: Required registered icon ID (custom image paths supported)
props.pressed: Optional boolean; caller owns toggle state
props.pressedIcon: Required for the toggle variant; registered icon ID or custom image path shown while pressed. The resting asset comes from icon.
props.size: 32 (default) or 40; observed action and toolbar sizes
props.variant: default, compact, composer, dark, dark-quiet, or toggle. Toggle is the quiet artwork-swap treatment: 24px target, 16px artwork, no container, accent artwork while pressed. Dark and dark-quiet are for dark surfaces; dark-quiet has no hover container — its artwork sits at reduced opacity and reaches full opacity on hover, active and pressed. Opacity is used rather than colour so artwork supplied as a path (rendered as ) is affected too.

anatomy.alignment: Centered image canvases: 20px for normal 32px and composer 28px controls, 24px for 40px controls, 18px for 24px window controls. Artwork has shared optical corrections inside each canvas.
anatomy.behavior: Native keyboard activation; disabled controls cannot activate. Split actions have independent callbacks. The dark-quiet variant paints no hover background; it changes artwork opacity only, so it can sit directly on a filled row without drawing a second container. The toggle variant swaps between its two supplied artwork states with no container in any state.
anatomy.ownership: Component owns its internal spacing and hit area. Parent owns spacing between controls.
anatomy.interactionOwnership: Owns control semantics and visual treatment for activation, focus, disabled and optional pressed values for each size. The caller owns the toggle value and updates the documented pressed input (aria-pressed); this is distinct from transient active interaction. The toggle variant swaps artwork between icon and pressedIcon under the same contract.

components.name: Button
components.usage: An action with an optional icon. Use primary for the main action. Optional iconColor tints catalog monochrome icons; currentColor follows the control color.

props.label: Required visible or accessible label
props.icon: Optional registered icon ID (custom image paths supported). The icon is a content slot the component owns — a 24px box with --titan-icon-size-action artwork and the icon-to-label gap — so every variant renders with or without one. Supplying an icon is an instance, not a variant.
props.variant: default, toolbar, composer, outlined, outlined-primary, primary, or dark. Primary uses accent fill with inverse text and standard button sizing. Outlined primary reuses Outlined geometry with accent text, icon and border, and semibold weight.

anatomy.behavior: Native keyboard activation; disabled controls cannot activate. Split actions have independent callbacks.
anatomy.ownership: Component owns its internal spacing and hit area: the base button matches the shared control height (--titan-control-height-default) with 16px horizontal insets, while Toolbar, Composer and Dark pin their own compact heights. Parent owns spacing between controls.
anatomy.interactionOwnership: Owns button states across variants. Action-group spacing is layout, not an additional interaction owner.

components.name: Split button
components.usage: A main action and a separate secondary trigger, composed from two registered Half button instances. Optional iconColor tints catalog monochrome icons; currentColor follows the control color.

props.label: Required visible or accessible label
props.icon: Optional registered icon ID (custom image paths supported)
props.secondaryLabel: Required accessible name for secondary action
props.secondaryIcon: Optional registered icon ID for the secondary half; defaults to chevron-down
props.secondaryHaspopup: Optional aria-haspopup for the secondary half; defaults to menu. Pass false to omit.
props.secondaryExpanded: Optional boolean reflected on the secondary half's aria-expanded

anatomy.alignment: Arranges two Half button instances; each half owns its content alignment.
anatomy.behavior: Composes the left and right Half button renderers unchanged; the group provides role=group and the accessible label. Split actions have independent callbacks; neither half fires the other's action.
anatomy.ownership: Split button owns only the group arrangement and accessible label. Half button owns the segment surface, radii, divider, insets and states.
anatomy.interactionOwnership: Value ownership: none; caller supplies disabled and expanded values to the halves. Control ownership: Half button owns each segment's semantics and hover, active, focus and disabled treatment for both side variants. Action ownership: the caller connects independent main (left) and secondary (right) callbacks. Composes registered children unchanged; do not restate their state previews here.

components.name: Half button
components.usage: One segment of a split control, used on the left or right side. Content instances: icon only, text only, or icon and text. The preview shows each half as an individual component.

props.side: Required: left or right; selects the registered variant and joining geometry.
props.label: Required accessible name; visible unless labelHidden.
props.icon: Optional registered icon ID (custom image paths supported).
props.labelHidden: Boolean; renders an icon-only segment and uses label as the accessible name.
props.size: default or composer; composer uses the observed 32px split geometry.
props.haspopup: Optional aria-haspopup value for menu-trigger halves.
props.expanded: Optional boolean reflected on aria-expanded; caller owns menu visibility.

anatomy.alignment: Left and right variants share the joined split geometry; icon-only and text-only instances rebalance their own insets.
anatomy.behavior: Native button with independent focus, disabled and menu-expanded semantics. The caller connects activation callbacks; neither half fires the other's action.
anatomy.ownership: Half button owns its surface, outer radii, leading divider, insets, icon slot and states. Split button owns only the group arrangement and accessible label.
anatomy.interactionOwnership: Value ownership: caller-supplied disabled and expanded values. Control ownership: Half button owns activation, hover, active, focus and disabled treatment for both side variants. Action ownership: the caller connects the left (main) and right (secondary) callbacks; neither half fires the other's action.

components.name: Message list
components.usage: Browse messages in stacked or single-line rows.

props.content: messages[] with id, sender, subject, preview, time, unread, selected, checked, starred

anatomy.ownership: List owns row arrangement, the between-row gap, wide-layout outer insets and scrolling. Message row owns each item’s internal spacing.
anatomy.behavior: Composes Message rows unchanged; open, check and star callbacks. Caller owns message data and selected row. Single-line rows retain a 640px minimum width and scroll horizontally in narrow containers.
anatomy.alignment: Rows share aligned sender/subject columns in wide layout; stacked rows align text to a common left edge.
anatomy.interactionOwnership: Composes Message row; row opening, selection, focus and star behavior belong to that component.

components.name: Message row
components.usage: Individual message summary with selection, star and open actions.

props.content: id, sender, subject, preview, time, unread, selected, checked, starred

anatomy.ownership: Row owns insets, internal gaps and summary layout. Parent owns list arrangement, outer spacing and scrolling.
anatomy.behavior: Composes the shared Checkbox and Icon button (Icon toggle variant, pressed) unchanged; open is a row-owned button. Open, check and star callbacks. Caller owns message data and selected row. Single-line rows retain a 640px minimum width and scroll horizontally in narrow containers.
anatomy.alignment: Rows share aligned sender/subject columns in wide layout; stacked rows align text to a common left edge.
anatomy.interactionOwnership: Owns row opening, selected/read state and row-specific star action. The caller owns checked/starred values; the row routes check/star actions and callbacks. Shared Checkbox and Icon button own control semantics and rendering of those supplied values, including focus, pressed treatment and the Icon toggle artwork swap. Do not duplicate child visual state galleries here; verify row state propagation and callback integration.
anatomy.selectionSurface: Highlight paint spans the full control height, is inset horizontally by --titan-selection-inset (4px), and uses --titan-selection-radius (4px). Control hit area and content geometry are unchanged. Selected/hover fills stay within this surface; keyboard focus remains independently visible.

components.name: Received message
components.usage: A received message, collapsed or expanded.

props.content: id, sender, initials?, recipients?, time, preview, paragraphs[], headerActions[], actions[]
props.headerActions: Uses shared TitanActions.iconButton (compact, unchanged); each action has id, label, icon and disabled.
props.actions: Uses shared TitanActions.button (unchanged); each action has id, label, optional icon and disabled. Actions are routed through external wrappers.

anatomy.ownership: Component owns internal spacing. Parent owns placement, external spacing and pane dimensions. Existing shell retains its 8px card stack gap.
anatomy.behavior: Collapsed trigger requests expansion through callback. Expanded body wraps text. Optional footer and header actions compose shared Button and Icon button instances unchanged behind action wrappers. Caller owns expansion, reply handling and message data.
anatomy.alignment: Sender and recipients form a tight text stack; footer actions wrap when needed.
anatomy.interactionOwnership: Owns collapsed-to-expanded message presentation and action routing through external wrappers. Footer actions reuse Button and header actions reuse Icon button (compact); their hover, focus, pressed and disabled states stay documented at those owners. Do not duplicate child state previews here.

props.label: Required accessible name
props.options: placeholder, value, filter, filterLabel, icon, disabled, readOnly
props.sizing: Fluid parent width; component-owned height 38px and 16px search icon. The filter slot is the Dropdown trigger's own 38px width.

anatomy.ownership: Component owns field geometry and insets; parent owns width, surrounding spacing and placement. The filter action is an unchanged Dropdown trigger instance that retains its own hit area and states.
anatomy.behavior: Native search input; Enter invokes search. The filter trigger is an unchanged Dropdown trigger whose activation calls the filter callback. No menu or backend is implied.
anatomy.alignment: Centered icon in a fixed slot. Fixed hit-area dimensions are not padding tokens.
anatomy.interactionOwnership: Owns input editing and field layout. The filter trigger is a registered Dropdown trigger instance (search variant); it owns its hit area, hover, focus, disabled and activation semantics, and the caller connects activation to the filter callback.

props.label: Required accessible name
props.options: icon, count, selected, muted, disabled, expanded
props.action: Optional trailing action, passed straight to Icon button: {icon, label, variant, size, iconSize, disabled}. Selects the With trailing action variant. Its label is required. Use Icon button's dark-quiet variant on dark navigation surfaces: it changes artwork opacity on hover instead of painting a container, so it does not draw a second box inside the row's own fill.

anatomy.ownership: Item owns its icon slot, label, count and insets. In the With trailing action variant the row owns the arrangement and the end inset, and carries the selection/hover fill and the item's focus ring so they extend behind the action. The nested Icon button owns its own size, artwork, hover, pressed and focus treatment. Parent owns external placement and the navigation surface colours.
anatomy.behavior: Native button. Reports activation through the activate callback; selection, count, muted and disabled are caller-supplied. A trailing action renders the registered Icon button as a sibling, not nested inside the item, so both stay separately focusable; the item element remains a button in both variants. Load components/actions.js before this module for the trailing-action variant.
anatomy.alignment: 18px image centered in the existing 20px slot. The hit area and all spacing are unchanged.
anatomy.interactionOwnership: Owns navigation activation, selection and its defined states. The trailing action is an Icon button instance and retains that component's interaction contract, accessible name and disabled state; its click is reported through the action callback and stops propagation so it does not also activate the item.
anatomy.selectionSurface: Highlight paint spans the full control height, is inset horizontally by --titan-selection-inset (4px), and uses --titan-selection-radius (4px). Control hit area and content geometry are unchanged. Selected/hover fills stay within this surface; keyboard focus remains independently visible.

components.name: Tab
components.usage: One selectable tab within a Tabs group.

anatomy.ownership: Tab owns its hit area, horizontal insets, label/count and state paint.
anatomy.behavior: Native button activation emits activate(id). Caller supplies selected via mount handle.update({selected}).
anatomy.interactionOwnership: Tab owns hover, focus and activation; selected is supplied state.

components.name: Tabs
components.usage: Arrange tabs and coordinate selection and keyboard navigation; content panels belong to the caller.

props.label: Required accessible label
props.options: One or more items with unique id, label, optional count/panel; value selects a tab. No fixed item-count limit.
props.variant: filled (default) or underline, forwarded to each Tab

anatomy.ownership: Group owns horizontal arrangement and keyboard traversal. Tab owns child geometry and states.
anatomy.behavior: Arrow keys/Home/End focus and request selection. With value, caller updates via handle.update({value}); without value, group manages selection. Cleanup handle removes listeners.
anatomy.interactionOwnership: Composes registered Tab controls; coordinates one keyboard entry and selection requests.

components.name: Dropdown trigger
components.usage: A trigger for caller-owned menu content. The search variant is an icon-only chevron filter trigger for input rows.

props.label: Required accessible label
props.variant: Text (default), app-switcher (icon required), composer, account (full-width dark trigger), account-light (the same trigger on a light surface, bordered instead of filled) or search (icon-only filter trigger filling an input row's height).
props.disabled: Boolean; disables the trigger. Supported by the search variant.
props.controls: Optional controlled panel DOM id for app-switcher trigger; emits aria-controls. App trigger advertises a nonmodal dialog.

anatomy.ownership: Control owns internal spacing; parent owns surrounding layout.
anatomy.behavior: Native button invokes open callback; caller supplies and manages the menu. Account label truncates with ellipsis at constrained widths while retaining its full accessible name. Account uses shared focus and native keyboard activation. No account menu is supplied.
anatomy.interactionOwnership: Owns trigger activation and focus; caller owns menu content and visibility.

components.name: Checkbox
components.usage: Native selection control.

anatomy.ownership: Control owns its size through --titan-checkbox-size (14px default, 20px on the Large variant); parent owns surrounding layout. Consumers select a supported size rather than overriding width/height.
anatomy.behavior: Native checkbox reports checked state through change callback. No padding. Two supported sizes: 14px default and 20px Large for denser list rows; both keep the same native control and interactions.
anatomy.interactionOwnership: Owns native checked state and focus.

components.name: Grouped actions
components.usage: A horizontal group of icon-and-label action buttons.

props.label: Required accessible group label
props.items: Button options; observed toolbar sizing is applied.

anatomy.ownership: Group owns horizontal alignment, the 4px gap and the action wrappers that carry routing ids; child Button markup stays unchanged. Button owns each action’s inset and icon-label spacing. Parent supplies available width.
anatomy.interactionOwnership: No group-owned interaction. Child Button owns hover, focus, pressing and disabled states; the group only routes wrapper ids to callbacks.
anatomy.behavior: Semantic group with native child buttons; routing ids live on group-owned wrappers. No toolbar-specific arrow navigation or additional group state is implied.

components.name: App switcher panel

props.apps: Array of app tile data: id, label, icon.
props.background: Optional surface artwork path; defaults to shared bubble asset.
props.divider: Optional divider artwork path; defaults to shared asset.

anatomy.ownership: Owns white bubble surface and pointer, section spacing, divider, tool list and supporting-link layout. App grid owns tile arrangement. No trigger or opening behavior; selection is bound through mount/bind and emits an item id.
anatomy.behavior: Presentational composition; native child buttons retain accessible names and keyboard activation. Parent owns placement.
anatomy.interactionOwnership: Child controls own hover/focus. Does not own popup visibility.

components.usage: White popover surface containing App grid, tools and supporting links.

components.name: App grid

props.apps: Array of app tile data: id, label, icon.

anatomy.ownership: Owns a three-column arrangement, row gaps and grid insets. App tile owns each tile. Supports any number of app items, including a partial final row; selected identifies the current app.
anatomy.behavior: Three columns at the observed 280px width. Any item count is rendered, including partial final rows. Each child is a native button; mount/bind emit the selected item id and return cleanup. Very narrow containers and long labels are not approved variants.
anatomy.interactionOwnership: Child controls own hover/focus. Does not own popup visibility.

components.usage: Three-column grid of shared App tiles.

components.name: App tile
components.usage: An app icon and label as one action.

anatomy.interactionOwnership: Owns its action hover/focus.
anatomy.ownership: Parent owns placement; this component owns internal spacing.
anatomy.behavior: Native action; caller handles selection. A selected tile is the app the user is currently in: it carries a resting container and aria-current, supplied through the renderer selected input by App grid.

components.name: Launcher item
components.usage: A tool or supporting link in the app launcher.

anatomy.interactionOwnership: Owns its action hover/focus.
anatomy.ownership: Parent owns placement; this component owns internal spacing.
anatomy.behavior: Native action; caller handles selection.
anatomy.alignment: Supporting-link icons occupy 24px square regions; the beaker uses the full region with zero margins.
anatomy.selectionSurface: Highlight paint spans the full control height, is inset horizontally by --titan-selection-inset (4px), and uses --titan-selection-radius (4px). Control hit area and content geometry are unchanged. Selected/hover fills stay within this surface; keyboard focus remains independently visible.

anatomy.ownership: Component owns row layout, insets and the input area; parent owns placement and available width. Cc/Bcc are unchanged Button instances that retain their own spacing and control states.
anatomy.behavior: Fluid parent width. Input shrinks with min-width:0; label and trailing actions retain intrinsic width. Sender is read-only. Cc/Bcc emit commands through the caller callback; recipient completion and expansion are not implemented.
anatomy.interactionOwnership: Value ownership: the caller supplies the initial input value; editing stays native and the row stores no value after mount. Control ownership: the field row owns the input and row semantics; Cc/Bcc control treatment belongs to their Button instances. Action ownership: the caller connects the Cc/Bcc command callback.

props.label: Required visible field label.
props.recipient: Shows Cc and Bcc actions, each an unchanged composer Button instance.
props.callbacks.action: Cc or Bcc command; native input editing remains local.

anatomy.ownership: Component owns internal spacing; parent owns placement and available width. Nested controls retain their spacing contracts.
anatomy.behavior: Parent-controlled width, 48px height; horizontal overflow keeps controls reachable. Formatting and menus are caller-owned callbacks; source supplies no editor commands.
anatomy.interactionOwnership: Child interactions belong to the dependency components. Field editing is native. Product operations require caller callbacks.

props.callbacks.action: Named formatting command; dropdowns emit their visible label. mount returns cleanup. No formatting operation is implemented.
command string and original event; mount returns cleanup. No window/editor mutations when mounted standalone.
props.title: Visible title; defaults to New email. Title activation emits Minimize.

anatomy.ownership: Owns title, 44px height, insets and window-action arrangement. Reuses unchanged dark Icon buttons.
anatomy.behavior: Native child controls emit semantic commands through mount callbacks. No sending, formatting or page action is implied.
anatomy.interactionOwnership: Owns the title button focus and activation (Minimize command). Window-icon states belong to Icon button. The host handles window effects.

props.callbacks.action: command string and original event; mount returns cleanup. No window/editor mutations when mounted standalone.

anatomy.ownership: Owns compose-feature row insets, 8px external control gaps and horizontal scrolling. Reuses unchanged composer Buttons. This is not Action group.
anatomy.behavior: Native child controls emit semantic commands through mount callbacks. No sending, formatting or page action is implied.
anatomy.interactionOwnership: Child button states belong to their registered owners. Standalone composition emits commands; host handles effects.

props.callbacks.action: command string and original event; mount returns cleanup. No window/editor mutations when mounted standalone.

anatomy.ownership: Owns send/insert action arrangement, insets, spacer and scrolling. Reuses unchanged composer Split button and Icon buttons.
anatomy.behavior: Native child controls emit semantic commands through mount callbacks. No sending, formatting or page action is implied.
anatomy.interactionOwnership: Child button states belong to their registered owners. Standalone composition emits commands; host handles effects.

anatomy.ownership: Owns outer 681px × 640px composition, field-region insets and editable body. Header, tools, formatting and send actions are registered children with their own spacing. Parent owns placement and available width.
anatomy.behavior: Preferred width 681px and height 640px, constrained by parent width. Body fills remaining height and scrolls; fields and toolbars remain fixed. Open/close/minimize belong to the window. Sending, menus, formatting, recipients and feature operations are caller-owned.
anatomy.interactionOwnership: Owns minimize state and close request. Native body editing is local. Child controls emit commands; host owns sending, formatting, menus, expansion and navigation.

props.title: Header title; defaults to New email.
props.docked: Uses existing bottom-docked motion and elevation; host supplies placement and comp-open state.
props.callbacks: action(command,event), minimize(boolean), close(). mount returns listener cleanup. Split Send emits main/secondary; other controls emit named commands.

props.label: Required accessible name unless decorative
props.decorative: Boolean; renders aria-hidden with no accessible name, for use inside a control that already names it
props.variant: default (36px) or small (24px); omitted defaults to default

anatomy.ownership: Avatar owns its circle (36px default, 24px small), purple surface, centred initials and zero padding in both variants. Parent owns external placement and gaps. Consumers select a variant without overriding internal styling.
anatomy.behavior: Fixed square that does not grow or shrink. Both sizes retain --titan-type-control-size typography and the same appearance. Initials must be short; overflow is clipped. No color variants are registered.
anatomy.interactionOwnership: Presentational only; no interactions defined.

components.name: Sidebar header

anatomy.ownership: Header owns 64px height, 12px inline insets, 11px trigger-to-logo gap and logo placement. Parent owns width. Dropdown owns its internal padding. App icon is instance content, not a variant.
anatomy.behavior: 64px header with logo and trigger content slot. The page supplies a trigger or rendered interaction pattern and initializes its behavior.
anatomy.interactionOwnership: No header-owned actions. Dropdown trigger owns its own states; the consuming page initializes any associated popup interaction pattern.

components.usage: TitanSidebarHeader.render({icon,logo,label,expanded}); load icons/runtime.js, then selection.js first. One default layout; icon varies per instance. Menu handlers remain caller-owned. Content slots: icon is a registered app icon ID or custom image path; logo is the brand image path (current alt: Titan). These accept asset paths, not arbitrary markup. Changing either is instance data, never a variant.

props.trigger: Optional trusted rendered trigger slot, supplied by page code. The page initializes any associated interaction pattern.

components.name: Mini calendar
components.usage: TitanMiniCalendar.mount(host,{value,month,locale,disabled},{dateChange,monthChange}) returns update(props) and destroy(). Emits optional callbacks and bubbling titan:dateChange / titan:monthChange events. Date is YYYY-MM-DD; month is YYYY-MM. No page navigation or fetching.

anatomy.behavior: Sunday-first month grid, adjacent-month dates, date selection, month browsing, arrow/Home/End/PageUp/PageDown keyboard focus. Enter/Space select; focus movement alone does not select. Fixed 250px width; no date-range selection.
anatomy.ownership: Calendar owns its fixed width, internal insets, header arrangement, grid and navigation wrappers. Calendar day owns the day buttons; Icon button owns arrow states. Parent owns placement, divider and external spacing.
anatomy.interactionOwnership: Owns date selection value, roving keyboard focus across the grid, visible month and arrow routing through wrappers. Calendar day owns each day button's semantics and visual states; Icon button owns the arrows. Emits signals only; optional host callbacks decide effects elsewhere.

components.name: Calendar day
components.usage: One date button in a Mini calendar grid. Required context: the calendar surface; the preview shows a single day on it.

anatomy.alignment: The parent grid sizes each cell; the day owns its radius, color and states.
anatomy.behavior: Native button. Mini calendar owns the selection value, roving tabindex, arrow-key movement and visible month; the day renders its own state.
anatomy.ownership: Calendar day owns its button semantics, color, radius and hover, selected, focus and disabled treatment. Mini calendar owns the grid arrangement and focus movement.
anatomy.interactionOwnership: Value ownership: caller supplies selected, outside and disabled values. Control ownership: Calendar day owns the button semantics and visual states. Action ownership: Mini calendar routes activation to the dateChange callback.
anatomy.selectionSurface: Highlight paint spans the full control height, is inset horizontally by --titan-selection-inset (4px), and uses --titan-selection-radius (4px). Control hit area and content geometry are unchanged. Selected/hover fills stay within this surface; keyboard focus remains independently visible.

components.name: Data list row
components.usage: One tabular record with control, key and value cells; used unchanged by Data list.

props.columns: columns[] with key, label, role (control/key/value) and width track
props.id: Row identifier used in slot addresses; use unique IDs, reserving head for the table header.
props.cells: Values keyed by column: text or {slot:true,text}; mount unchanged components into slots.
props.sharedTracks: true only when hosted in a grid with the same column tracks; Data list supplies this for subgrid alignment. Default false uses independent tracks.

anatomy.ownership: Row owns 66px minimum height, cell alignment, gap, insets, typography, separators and hover. Parent supplies column tracks, width and placement. Slots accept unchanged components; their sizes and behaviors belong to those components. Internal CSS variables are not customization APIs.
anatomy.behavior: Static role=row markup with role=cell children. Plain text is escaped. Key and value text truncate; slots retain child geometry. No events or selection state; callers mount and wire slotted controls.
anatomy.alignment: Independent tracks by default; sharedTracks opts into parent subgrid columns. Without subgrid support, fixed/fr tracks align but auto tracks may differ.
anatomy.interactionOwnership: Owns row hover appearance only. No activation or selection behavior; slotted controls retain their own states and callbacks.
anatomy.selectionSurface: Highlight paint spans the full control height, is inset horizontally by --titan-selection-inset (4px), and uses --titan-selection-radius (4px). Control hit area and content geometry are unchanged. Selected/hover fills stay within this surface; keyboard focus remains independently visible.

components.name: Data list
components.usage: Tabular rows separated by dividers, with caller-defined columns, one primary key column and per-cell component slots.

props.columns: columns[] with key, label, role (control/key/value) and width track
props.rows: rows[] with id and cells keyed by column; a cell is text or {slot:true, text}
props.head: false hides the column header row
props.label: accessible name for the table
props.emptyText: message shown when rows is empty

spacing.label: Header Key slot to key text

anatomy.ownership: List owns shared column tracks, header (62px minimum height), header rule and empty state. It composes Data list row unchanged. Parent owns available width and scrolling; callers supply data and mount unchanged children. Internal CSS variables are not customization APIs.
anatomy.behavior: Rows form one continuous surface divided by separators; there is no per-row container. Exactly one key column is required; control columns declare their own left/right insets and should use an auto track so no leftover width remains; value cells clip overflow with an ellipsis. Cells accept plain text or an empty slot host the caller fills with a component instance, addressed as [data-slot="<rowId>:<columnKey>"] with the header row using the id 'head'. Static markup only; the caller owns data, selection state and mounting.
anatomy.alignment: The list owns one set of column tracks; the header and every row span all columns and subgrid them, so each column resolves once from all content and stays aligned even with auto-sized control columns. Without subgrid support the header and rows fall back to repeating the same track list, which aligns fixed and fr tracks but not auto ones.
anatomy.interactionOwnership: Presentational container. Slotted controls retain their own interaction contracts and callbacks.

components.name: Sidebar footer actions
components.usage: One to three content-sized actions at the foot of a navigation surface. With three actions, the last is always icon-only.

props.label: Required accessible group label
props.items: One to three actions: {id, label, icon, iconColor, labelHidden, disabled}. Every label is required. Three actions always show the first two labels and hide the last label visually. With one or two actions, labelHidden is optional.

anatomy.ownership: Group owns content-based width allocation, insets, the leading rule and between-segment dividers, and centered icon/label alignment. Labelled actions share spare width and shrink when necessary; icon-only actions reserve at least 48px, with centered artwork. Parent owns placement and available width. No consumer overrides.
anatomy.behavior: One to three native buttons. Three actions show two labels followed by one icon-only button with an accessible name. Labelled actions use intrinsic content widths plus an equal share of spare space; labels ellipsize only when the available width is exhausted, with full text retained in the accessible name and title. Clicks route by item id. Disabled actions do not invoke callbacks.
anatomy.alignment: Icon and label are centred together within each segment.
anatomy.interactionOwnership: Each segment is a native button owning its own hover, focus and disabled state; the caller owns what each action does.

components.name: Account header
components.usage: Expandable account row heading a group of folders in a navigation sidebar.

props.email: Required address shown as the account name; truncates with an ellipsis
props.initials: Required initials passed to the nested Avatar
props.expanded: Boolean, default true; reflected on aria-expanded
props.id: Reported as data-action and to the toggle callback

anatomy.ownership: Account header owns the chevron box, external avatar-to-address gap and address truncation. It renders the nested Avatar using its registered small variant at 24px and purple surface. No child styling overrides are supported. Parent owns sidebar placement and surrounding rules.
anatomy.behavior: Native button. Toggles aria-expanded on click and reports the new state through the toggle callback; the caller owns showing or hiding the folders beneath it. Collapsing rotates the chevron. Addresses longer than the row truncate with an ellipsis — that is inherent, not a separate variant.
anatomy.alignment: Chevron, avatar and address share one centred row; the address takes the remaining width.
anatomy.interactionOwnership: Owns its own click, expanded state, focus and disabled treatment.

patterns.name: Three-pane workspace
patterns.summary: Three adjacent sections with a full-height left section and a shared upper section above the middle and right.
structure: Upper section spanning the middle and right
requirements: The left section spans the full height; the upper section spans the two remaining columns.
Column widths, scrolling and the smaller-screen arrangement are chosen by the consuming screen.
Sections accept any content; this layout assigns no content roles.
useWhen: Arranging three adjacent sections with a shared upper section over the last two.

patterns.name: Overlay side panel
patterns.summary: An elevated panel opens over the workspace.
structure: Right-aligned panel, 316px wide, full viewport height.
Fixed header, scrollable settings area and bottom action.

patterns.name: Layout guide
patterns.summary: Explore lists, grids and rows with the Titan spacing scale. Guidelines, not required code utilities.
useWhen: Creating or rearranging a DS screen: consult alongside components and tokens.
structure: One switchable guide for List, Grid, Row and Footer arrangements.
requirements: Choose context before spacing: data rows 0, launcher menu items 4px, Contacts navigation 8px, app grids 16px. Form/card recommendations are provisional. See layouts/README.md for evidence and separate group/inset guidance.
Parent owns gaps, outer padding, alignment, wrapping and columns. Child internals remain unchanged.
Apply guidance through existing screen code; no mandatory layout class, import or renderer.
See layouts/README.md for defaults, override boundaries and usage.

patterns.name: Anchored popover disclosure
patterns.summary: A registered trigger reveals a caller-owned floating panel anchored to it; the page coordinates visibility, placement, dismissal and focus.
structure: Trigger (a registered control, e.g. Dropdown trigger).
Floating panel (a separate registered surface; App switcher panel is the reference implementation).
Page-owned coordination: visibility, placement, dismissal and focus return.
requirements: Trigger and panel stay independently registered; do not fold the panel into the trigger component or treat it as the trigger's hover, pressed or selected state.
The page owns open/close state, outside-click and Escape dismissal, focus return and the panel's actions.
Render the panel in a container that can extend outside the sidebar or parent layout, and keep it within the viewport.
Reference implementation: the App switcher coordination (patterns/app-switcher.js and patterns/app-switcher.css, bound by the page).
useWhen: A short-lived choice or navigation surface anchored to its trigger.
The panel content is page-owned or a separate registered surface.
avoid: Do not restyle the trigger or the panel internals from the parent.
Do not imply a route or a persistent page change; the disclosure is transient.
